  id = {EDN-25},
  title = {The \texorpdfstring{\texttt{download}}{download} stage fetches the raw file from Zenodo},
  note = {\textbf{Absorbs EDN-07, EDN-35, and EDN-36} (2026-09-22 to 2026-09-30).},
  date = {2026-09-26},
  milestone = {M2: Reproducibility},
  topic = {Data Versioning, Pipeline Design},
  participants = {@W11W11W11 decided the \texttt{dvc add} form of 2026-09-26, @lukas2510 the current form of 2026-09-30; the full team confirmed the current form at the laboratory session of 2026-10-13},
  decision = {The \texttt{download} stage fetches the pinned AutoScout24 CSV from its Zenodo record and writes \texttt{data/\allowbreak{}raw/\allowbreak{}listings.\allowbreak{}parquet}, its only output.
The CSV stays a local cache under \texttt{data/\allowbreak{}external/\allowbreak{}}, and \texttt{download.\allowbreak{}md5} in \texttt{params.\allowbreak{}yaml} pins its bytes.
We neither track nor host the CSV.
This replaced, on 2026-09-30, the \texttt{dvc add} pointer chosen on 2026-09-26.},
  rationale = {\emph{Alternatives considered:}
\begin{itemize}[leftmargin=*, topsep=2pt]
\item \texttt{dvc import-\allowbreak{}url} with \texttt{push: false}, the first decision of 2026-09-22: Zenodo sends neither an \texttt{ETag} nor a \texttt{Content-\allowbreak{}MD5} header, which DVC's change detection relies on.
\item \texttt{dvc add} and push to DagsHub, chosen on 2026-09-26: the course demo's pattern, but acquisition stays a manual step and we re-host the CSV.
\item The CSV as a dependency or output of the stage: DVC would hash the whole file on every \texttt{dvc status}.
\end{itemize}
\par
\emph{Why:} Once the pipeline exists it should acquire its own input, so a clean clone reproduces with \texttt{dvc repro} and no manual step.
The stage hashes the cached file on every run and refuses any other bytes.},
  ai = {Information seeking, Alternative generation, Alternative assessment, Recommendation, Solution generation},
  response = {Other: rejected on 2026-09-26, partly adopted on 2026-09-30},
  assessment = {AI recommended \texttt{dvc import-\allowbreak{}url}, to keep the raw personal data off our remote.
@W11W11W11 rejected that for \texttt{dvc add}, because the course demo teaches it.
Four days later @lukas2510 retired the pointer, so that the pipeline owns its input.
That adopts the recommendation only in part: the file comes from Zenodo again, but \texttt{dvc import-\allowbreak{}url} stays rejected and its aim is not met, because the raw Parquet with the same seven personal-data columns is pushed to our public remote (EDN-20).
AI's claim that DVC cannot keep such a file in the graph was wrong; an AI review found the option.},
  aievidence = {Claude Code sessions of 2026-09-26 (issue \#3) and 2026-09-30 (issue \#33, review of PR \#54).},
